purpose: Freeze a GPFS-independent in-memory reference/JAX likelihood contract before any inference execution.

coordinate_and_velocity_units.observer_frame: observer velocity is removed before the kernel; Hubble flow is not included in peculiar velocity

selection_exposure.shape: (6,N,N,N) with one common cubic spatial grid
selection_exposure.normalization: raw exposure; never rescaled to observed population totals

redshift_space_model.small_scale_broadening: population-specific FoG and measurement-redshift sigma combined in quadrature
redshift_space_model.convergence_gate: GH3 must be compared with GH7 or GH9 on predeclared boundary-stress inputs before inference

jax.ownership_policy: only the host checked bridge may call the JAX joint kernel

required_gates_before_KF_EXPAND: unit conversion regression at z=0 and a<1
periodic TSC mass conservation and adjoint
finite log-domain likelihood and zero-support rejection
secure object/group identity and duplicate-factor negative tests
JAX value and gradient comparison on the same synthetic input
validated object-level CF4--2M++ manifest with source SHA256 binding
GH3 versus GH7/9 boundary-stress result recorded
independent development and untouched validation mock calibration

required_components: independent development and untouched validation seeds
mock_calibration.KF_EXPAND_release: forbidden until all components and coverage gates pass
